parts.text: A student determines the density of a block of wood.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Fig. 1.1 shows one face of the block of wood that the student uses. Fig. 1.1

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) The student measures the height h of the block of wood. 4.0 h = .................................................... cm Calculate the volume V of the block of wood using the equation V = l × w × h . V = ............................................. cm 3 [1]

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) The student measures the mass m of the block of wood on a balance. Fig. 1.2 Write down the mass m of the block as shown in Fig. 1.2. Give your answer to the nearest gram. m = ................................................. g [1]

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Calculate the density ρ of the wood using the equation ρ = m V . Give your answer to a suitable number of significant figures for this experiment and include the unit. ρ = .................................................... [2]

ms.label: 1(a)(iv)
ms.text:
ρ to 2 or 3 significant figures
unit g / cm
3

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The student places the block of wood carefully in water in a glass dish. The wood floats as shown in Fig. 1.3. Fig. 1.3

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Using Fig. 1.3, estimate, without taking a measurement, the volume V 1 of wood that is below the water surface. V 1 = ............................................. cm 3 [1]

ms.label: 1(b)(i)
ms.text:
estimate of V1 given to the nearest cm and > ½V < V

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Calculate m W , the mass of water with volume V 1 , using the equation m W = ρ W × V 1 , where ρ W = 1.00 in the same units as ρ in part (a)(iv) . m W = .................................................... [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) A student suggests that the mass m of the block of wood should be equal to the mass m W of the water with volume V 1 .

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Calculate the difference d between your values of m and m W . d = .................................................... [1]

ms.label: 1(c)(ii)
ms.text: YES/NO and suitable comparison of d with m or mW
